role: The codec check of src/lzpack.h (make lzpack-check, which make test runs): round trips over lengths 0 to 300 and long inputs of every shape the format has a path for (runs at offsets 1 to 20, long literal and match lengths, offsets at 65535, incompressible bytes), with no write past the decoder's slack, then streams cut short, a cap below the length and flipped bytes, each refused or decoded inside its buffer.
notes: A plain program, not a test_*.c: those take a recording directory (tests/input_guard.c).
